items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: This past season probably the highlight for me was working with Brandi Carlisle.

ctx.x: Just a personal aside I was happy to see a Hamilton alum from our college playing bass with Dua Lipa on Saturday Night Live. That was really cool.

Yeah she’s fun. She can sing, that’s a fun band. This past season probably the highlight for me was working with Brandi Carlisle. She was just sublime. You know great voice, great songs, great players. And it was just playing. It was like no click-track, no tracks or whatnot. And I don’t mean that in a dismissive way because you know playing back pre- recorded tracks or whatever sonic signature that has been created with loops and beats and editing and so forth you know from the get-go that is not something that…
Do people use in-ear monitors on the show?
